import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static long n;
    static int k;
    static int[][][] prefix = new int[100][][];
    
    static int add_mod(int a, int b) {
        int res = a + b;
        if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
        return res;
    }

    static int sub_mod(int a, int b) {
        int res = a - b;
        if (res < 0) res += MOD;
        return res;
    }

    static int mul_mod(int a, int b) {
        return (int)((1L * a * b) % MOD);
    }

    static int[][] multiply_matrices(int[][] A, int[][] B, int size) {
        int[][] C = new int[size][size];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                int sum = 0;
                for (int t = 0; t < size; t++) {
                    sum = add_mod(sum, mul_mod(A[i][t], B[t][j]));
                }
                C[i][j] = sum;
            }
        }
        return C;
    }

    static int[][] shift(int[][] mat, int size) {
        int[][] res = new int[size][size];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            int ni = i;
            if (ni < size - 1) ni = (ni + size - 1) % size;
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                int nj = j;
                if (nj < size - 1) nj = (nj + size - 1) % size;
                res[i][j] = mat[ni][nj];
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void setup() {
        long temp = n;
        int count_digits = 0;
        while (temp > 0) {
            temp /= k;
            count_digits++;
        }
        prefix[0] = new int[k + 1][k + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
            prefix[0][i][i] = 1;
        }
        prefix[0][0][k] = 1;
        prefix[0][k][0] = (int)(MOD - 1);
        prefix[0][k][k] = 2;

        for (int step = 0; step < count_digits; step++) {
            int[][] current = prefix[step];
            int[][] next = new int[k + 1][k + 1];
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                System.arraycopy(current[i], 0, next[i], 0, k + 1);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
                current = shift(current, k + 1);
                next = multiply_matrices(next, current, k + 1);
            }
            prefix[step + 1] = next;
        }
    }

    static int[][] get_matrix(long n_value) {
        int size = k + 1;
        if (n_value == 0) {
            int[][] c = new int[size][size];
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) c[i][i] = 1;
            return c;
        }
        long pw = 1;
        int d = 0;
        while (pw <= n_value / k) {
            pw *= k;
            d++;
        }
        if (n_value == pw) return prefix[d];
        long steps = n_value / pw;
        long rem = n_value - steps * pw;
        int[][] matrix_curr = new int[size][size];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            matrix_curr[i][i] = 1;
        }
        int[][] coef = prefix[d];
        for (int i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
            matrix_curr = multiply_matrices(matrix_curr, coef, size);
            coef = shift(coef, size);
        }
        int[][] matrix_left = get_matrix(rem);
        for (int i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
            matrix_left = shift(matrix_left, size);
        }
        return multiply_matrices(matrix_curr, matrix_left, size);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        setup();
        int[][] answer = get_matrix(n);
        System.out.println(answer[k][k]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
